The size of Cornyn's primary lead therefore conflicts between sources; no candidate reached 50%, forcing a 2026-05-26 runoff. 63.8%, a margin of more than 25 points, per the certified-result aggregate on the Wikipedia race article. Ellis Insight (2026-05-27) had projected 'exceeding 60 percent'. Trump endorsed Paxton on 2026-05-19, one week before the runoff, after staying neutral through the primary. Official canvass not retrieved.

Cornyn defeated by more than 25 points. Wikipedia states he became the first incumbent U.S. senator from Texas to lose renomination since 1970. Ellis Insight separately notes he was the second Senate incumbent to lose renomination in the 2026 cycle nationally, after Louisiana Sen. Bill Cassidy - the two claims are compatible (first from Texas since 1970; second nationally in 2026). After the runoff Cornyn said he would vote for Paxton and back the Republican ticket but would not actively campaign for him (Washington Examiner, 2026-06-09).
